messages.app.description: Sync your clipboard between your phone and computer
messages.about.title: About CSync
messages.sync.connected_hint: {device} · Your clipboard will stay in sync
messages.sync.paired_hint: Paired with {device}. Start syncing to connect.
messages.sync.pair_hint: Connect to your computer to sync your clipboard
messages.pair.instructions: Click Start pairing on your computer, then enter the IP address and port shown there.
messages.pair.wait_computer: Confirm this phone on your computer within 60 seconds.
messages.pair.failed: Pairing failed. Check the computer address and pairing status.
messages.pair.not_approved: The computer did not approve pairing
messages.pair.storage_failed: The computer could not save the pairing. Check the configuration folder and write permissions shown on the computer, then try again.
messages.pair.expired: Pairing was not approved or has expired
messages.pair.identity_mismatch: The computer's identity does not match. Pair again.
messages.hosts.edit_hint: Change this computer's connection address while keeping its paired identity.
messages.hosts.order_hint: Drag the handles on the right to reorder hosts. The top host has the highest connection priority.
messages.hosts.empty: Tap Add host, then enter your computer's IP address and port to pair.
messages.hosts.drag_accessibility: Drag to change the priority of {device}
messages.hosts.delete_hint: Delete {device} ({host}). To revoke this phone's access on the computer as well, revoke the device there.
messages.hosts.invalid_endpoint: Enter a valid computer IP address and a port from 1 to 65535
messages.hosts.invalid_address: Enter a valid address and a port from 1 to 65535
messages.hosts.duplicate: This address and port are already in the host list
messages.hosts.save_failed: Could not save the host list
messages.hosts.migration_failed: Could not migrate the host list
messages.background.privacy: Only newly copied text is synced. No history is saved. Content marked as sensitive is skipped.
messages.background.battery_enabled: Battery optimization is disabled for CSync
messages.background.battery_hint: Allow CSync to ignore battery optimization to reduce interruptions to background sync.
messages.background.settings_failed: Could not open system settings. Allow CSync to run in the background in your system settings.
messages.background.start_failed: The system did not allow background sync to start. Try again.
messages.background.boot_denied: The system restricted sync from resuming at startup. Open CSync.
messages.shizuku.permission_hint: Grant access to read the clipboard in the background.
messages.shizuku.start_hint: Start Shizuku, then return here to grant access.
messages.shizuku.start_first: Start Shizuku, then return here to grant access.
messages.shizuku.disconnected: Clipboard service disconnected. Waiting for it to recover.
messages.shizuku.stopped: Shizuku has stopped. Start it again.
messages.shizuku.permission_required: Grant Shizuku access on the app's home screen
messages.shizuku.connection_failed: Could not connect to the Shizuku service
messages.clipboard.interface_unavailable: Clipboard interface unavailable. Check system and Shizuku permissions.
messages.clipboard.read_restricted: Clipboard access is restricted. Unlock your device or check system permissions, then try again.
messages.sync.queue_full: The send queue is full. Copy the text again.
messages.sync.connection_failed: Connection failed. Check the computer, address, firewall, or pairing status.
messages.sync.retry: Disconnected. Retrying in about {seconds} seconds, or immediately if the network changes.
messages.sync.remote_not_applied: The computer has not applied the text: {status}
messages.protocol.invalid_order: Server messages arrived out of order
messages.windows.sync_subtitle: Sync your clipboard in real time
messages.windows.pair_instructions: Enter the computer's address and port on your phone, then verify the code to pair.
messages.windows.restart_hint: Port changes take effect after you quit and restart CSync
messages.windows.public_access_hint: You must configure router port forwarding and your firewall yourself
messages.windows.autostart_hint: Run quietly in the system tray
messages.windows.privacy_hint: Only plain text is synced. No clipboard history is saved. Revoking access requires all devices to pair again.
messages.windows.pair_verify: Make sure your phone shows the same verification code:
messages.windows.revoke_hint: Current connections will be disconnected. Devices will need to pair again.
messages.windows.invalid_port: Enter a whole number from 1 to 65535
messages.windows.close_to_tray: Sync continues when you close the window
messages.windows.close_to_exit: System tray unavailable. Closing the window will quit CSync.
messages.windows.no_addresses: No local network addresses found yet
messages.windows.endpoint_pending: Listening on port {port} · Saved port {savedPort} takes effect after restart
messages.windows.pair_open: Pairing is open. Waiting for your phone (up to 120 seconds).
messages.windows.tray_recovering: System tray icon unavailable. Restoring it automatically.
messages.windows.port_restart_required: The port has changed. Quit and restart CSync before pairing.
messages.windows.port_range: The port must be from 1 to 65535
messages.windows.settings_saved_restart: Settings saved. Quit and restart CSync to apply port changes.
messages.windows.network_failed: Could not start the network service: {error}
messages.windows.webview_failed: Could not open settings. Make sure Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is installed: {error}
messages.windows.pair_save_failed: Could not save the paired device
messages.windows.remote_not_applied: The phone has not written the text: {status}
messages.storage.no_exe_directory: Could not locate the application directory
messages.storage.create_data_failed: Could not create the data folder next to the application. Move the application to a writable folder.
messages.storage.migrate_publish_failed: Could not complete migration of the previous configuration
messages.storage.migrate_failed: Could not migrate the previous configuration. The original files have been kept.
messages.storage.create_temp_failed: Could not create the temporary configuration file {path}
messages.storage.write_temp_failed: Could not write the temporary configuration file
messages.storage.flush_temp_failed: Could not flush the temporary configuration file to disk
messages.language.title: Language
messages.language.hint: Changes take effect immediately. Untranslated text is shown as message keys.

Make sure the computer shows the same verification code:

{code}
messages.windows.devices_hint: Manage devices that sync with this computer.
messages.windows.shared_sync: Keep all your devices in sync
messages.windows.shared_sync_hint: This computer syncs newly copied text across all connected devices.
messages.windows.empty_devices_hint: Click Add device, enter this computer’s address and port on your phone, then verify the code on both devices.
messages.windows.delete_device_hint: Deleting {device} disconnects it and requires it to pair again before syncing. Other devices are not affected.
messages.windows.clipboard_privacy: Only plain text is synced. No clipboard history is saved.
messages.pair.scan_hint: Scan the QR code shown on your computer under Devices → Add device → Start pairing.
messages.pair.qr_hint: Scan with CSync on your phone, or enter the address and port below manually. This code expires when pairing ends and can only be used once.
messages.pair.qr_invalid: This is not a valid CSync pairing code. Scan the pairing code on your computer.
messages.pair.qr_unreachable: Cannot connect to this computer. Check that both devices are on the same local network, pairing is still open, and the firewall allows CSync. You can also enter the address manually.
messages.pair.camera_permission: Camera permission is required to scan. You can also go back and choose Enter manually.
messages.pair.camera_failed: Cannot open the camera. Check camera availability, or go back and enter the address manually.
messages.windows.startup_read_failed: Could not read Windows startup status: {error}
